title: ImUi Debug Draw Rounded Image v1
problem: Close the next Dear ImGui `ImDrawList` image gap by adding `AddImageRounded`-style rounded image and image-region clipping above existing scene image primitives without introducing image loading ownership, texture tinting, arbitrary mesh UVs, or renderer contract changes.

repro.summary: The IMUI debug-draw facade can record rounded full-image and rounded image-region commands, uses the same typed corner flags and `PathRect`-compatible rounding clamp as path rectangles, and lowers rounded image draws through `PushClipRRect` plus the existing `Image` / `ImageRegion` scene ops.
commands: cargo nextest run -p fret-ui-kit --features imui debug_draw --no-fail-fast

gates.name: debug draw tests
gates.command: cargo nextest run -p fret-ui-kit --features imui debug_draw --no-fail-fast

continue_policy.notes: This rounded image slice is closed. Start separate follow-ons for channel splitting, hit-test-aware debug interaction, reusable draw-list command metadata, image loading recipes, image tinting, arbitrary image quads, or multi-color rect fill. Do not implement `AddRectFilledMultiColor` as a single linear gradient: that needs an honest vertex-colored primitive or mesh contract.
